purpose: Fill Divination planner gaps for Equilibrium: multi-region wisp colony progression with boons/chronicles, Daemonheim (Forinthry) Time-Worn Memories route, Hall of Memories (Kandarin) refresh, Incandescent 95+, Skillchompas, and Tirannwn Amlodd energy pickpocket for Memorial prestige. Mid-Game Rebalance (2026-07-20) raised mid/high energy success rates but did not publish a new XP/h table — do not invent wisp rates. Divination_training wiki page is still bannered incomplete post-Div Improvements.
wiki_incompleteness_flags: https://runescape.wiki/w/Divination_training is bannered incomplete: needs more Hall of Memories XP rates on that page, non-enhanced and incandescent wisp rates, and a full update since the Div Improvements update.

July 2026 Mid-Game Rebalance only published average energy success rate increases for gleaming–incandescent (see midgame-rebalance-2026-07-20.json); no official post-rework wisp XP/h rebenchmark exists.

Hall of Memories has a dedicated rate table (urns + diviner's outfit assumptions) on https://runescape.wiki/w/Hall_of_Memories — more complete than the incomplete training-page summary line (110k–225k at 99).

Wisp colony summary XP/h table on Divination_training (5k–97k by tier) is present on-wiki but treated as stale/incomplete for optimizer ranking; numeric rates omitted from wisp progression methods below.
Incandescent detailed boosted rates (Divine Conversion / scrimshaw / bought energy) remain on the incomplete training page — included only as wiki-quoted candidates with explicit freshness warning.
Daemonheim Divination rates (350k–500k solo / 1m+ elite teams) are wiki estimates that vary heavily with floor speed and party; not a fixed post-rework table.
Amlodd worker pickpocket is an energy/prestige support route, not a primary Divination XP method; no reliable Divination XP/h on wiki for it.

midgame_rebalance_energy_success.patch_note: New unlocks receive a larger initial improvement before settling toward these average values. Patch targeted gathering consistency rather than publishing a new XP/h table.

methods.xp_rate: numeric_wiki_summary_rates_omitted_as_stale_incomplete; see colony table geography and midgame energy success deltas instead of ranking by XP/h
methods.intensity: low-to-medium AFK gathering; higher if chasing enriched springs / Memory Overflow on world 79
methods.location: Progress through standard wisp colonies; train on community Divination world 79 for enriched/Memory Overflow uptime
methods.notes: Core 1–99 path: harvest memories → convert at energy rift; craft each tier's boon ASAP (permanent +10% XP and energy when converting that tier). Empower rifts with chronicle / enhanced chronicle fragments for Memory Overflow and enriched wisp spawns (Abyssal Transit at Memorial doubles chronicle charge from 60 Div). Catch chronicles for Hunter XP (or Guthixian butterflies with Naragi engram). Charge Memorial to Guthix engrams with matching energy while gathering. Midgame rebalance improved energy success from gleaming upward — better energy stock for boons/porters/products, not a verified XP/h table rewrite.
methods.warning: Divination_training wiki is incomplete and still needs post-Div Improvements / post-rebalance XP rebenchmarks. Do not invent or promote summary 5k–97k wisp XP/h as post-rework optimizer truth. Enhanced-experience convert burns energy at high GP/XP and is usually avoided for iron/League self-supply.

methods.method: Memorial to Guthix engrams + boon pipeline
methods.level_range: 1–99 (engrams scale with energy tier; prestige from 80+ with high energy access)
methods.xp_rate: not a continuous XP/h method; one-time/prestige energy sinks that permanently buff Divination training
methods.intensity: planning + energy banking while training elsewhere
methods.location: Memorial to Guthix / Piscatoris Hunter area (Hall of Memories pool beneath)
methods.notes: Ironman/League priority: bank energy for the next boon and the matching engram while at each colony. Prestige costs scale per engram (Pale through Incandescent). Time-Worn Memories (Elder Sword engram, unlockable from 10 Div) is the Daemonheim 4x convert key. Ethereal Connection (World Gate engram) extends spring duration by 30s including Daemonheim springs. Abyssal Transit (60+) doubles chronicle empower charge. Aagi Hall bot unlocks a second active Memorial buff slot.
methods.warning: Do not treat engram charging as primary XP; it is permanent unlock infrastructure for all other Divination methods.

methods.level_range: 10–85+ practical; strongest with 85+ lustrous/brilliant/radiant dungeon wisps

xp_rate.solo_with_boosts_wiki: 350,000–500,000 Divination XP/h depending on wisp generation and floor completion speed
xp_rate.elite_team_large_floors_wiki: can exceed 1,000,000 Divination XP/h on 5–10 minute large floors

methods.intensity: active floors; 2-tick springs is click-intensive but lengthens AFK deposit windows
methods.location: Daemonheim (Forinthry/Wilderness elective; Equilibrium hard-maps Daemonheim to forinthry)
methods.notes: Unlock Time-Worn Memories via Elder Sword engram at Memorial to Guthix (available from 10 Div) — quadruples Divination XP from converting memories inside Daemonheim. Memories stack in inventory so convert rate beats surface for many setups. Stack: Ethereal Connection (longer springs, multiplayer spring extension), Scroll of gathering (80k DG tokens, +25% skilling XP in Daemonheim including Divination), Ring of Kinship gatherer upgrades, multi-player spring duration, 2-tick springs. Prefer lustrous/brilliant/radiant dungeon wisps at 85+. Also awards Dungeoneering XP. Boons do not apply in Daemonheim.
methods.warning: Rates depend on party speed and wisp rolls; not a fixed table. Requires Forinthry for Daemonheim access in Equilibrium. Scroll of gathering is a permanent Dungeoneering token unlock.

xp_rate.level_99_outfit_scrimshaw_corehunting: 400000+ on training-page high-end claim with 2-tick + elite outfit + energy-gathering scrimshaw; Hall page notes 300k+ at 99 with urns + elder outfit + clan avatar on 2-tick

methods.intensity: AFK faded/level-appropriate to very active 2-tick + corehunting
methods.location: Hall of Memories, beneath the Memorial to Guthix in the Piscatoris Hunter area
methods.notes: Equilibrium official Kandarin example. Rate table assumes decorated divination urns + full diviner's outfit. Fill memory jars from faded / level-appropriate / core memories and deposit at unstable rift (3,400 XP per jar). 2-tick = re-click after each XP drop (1.2s vs 1.8s). Core memory fragments + knowledge overflow (~hourly) add burst XP; community world 79 / Corehunting FC for shared cores. Memory-storage bots: Aagi 70 (second Memorial buff), Seren 80 (strand gain), Juna 85 (chronicle spawn chance — March 2026 effect rewrite), Edicts 90 (double faded jar fill), Cres 95 (+1 energy on convert). Backup bots after the five named ones give 10k Div XP each. Preferred surface alternative from 70+ when Forinthry Daemonheim is unavailable.
methods.warning: Divination_training still claims the page needs more Hall rates; prefer the dedicated Hall of Memories table above. Rates exclude corehunt/knowledge burst variance.

methods.intensity: low-medium AFK on world 79 with Memory Overflow; higher if tracking enriched spawns and chronicle empower
methods.location: Incandescent colony south of the Poison Waste (spirit tree Poison Waste / fairy BKP approaches); Max Guild portal optional
methods.notes: End-game surface colony. World 79 commonly keeps near-constant enriched spawns. Stack elder/diviner outfits, skillchompas, nightmare muspah / light creature, memory dowser, Chronicle Attraction, energy- or memory-crushing scrimshaw depending on energy vs XP goal, Prism of Dowsing, Divine Conversion relic. Cres Hall bot permanently improves energy on convert. Extreme divination boost path from 81 is a wiki-noted shortcut when potions are available. Midgame rebalance: +0.5% average energy success — small consistency buff only.
methods.warning: Quoted XP/h come from the incomplete Divination_training page and predate a clean post-midgame rebench. Prefer live measurement before optimizer ranking. Enhanced+bought-energy path is a cash sink, not League-default.

methods.level_range: 31+ Divination for cobalt; higher tiers scale to crystal (71 Div / 97 Hunter catch)
methods.xp_rate: not a standalone method; +10% base XP on successful Divination actions and 5% of a success on failed harvest attempts; +3%–22.5% enriched/critical chance by tier
methods.intensity: passive consumable while training any wisp or Hall method
methods.location: Wielded or in backpack while training Divination; caught via Hunter box traps / Manor Farm produce
methods.notes: Applies to Divination gathering: one skillchompa consumed per XP grant. Tiers (Div increase / crit): cobalt 3%, viridian 6%, azure 10%, crimson 15%, crystal 22.5%. Does not need to be wielded if in backpack (wielded takes priority). Multiplies with other base-XP and crit stacking (outfits, Memory Overflow, enriched springs). Supply cost is Hunter/farming gated in no-trade League — budget skillchompas as a Divination intensity/cost lever, not free XP.
methods.warning: Do not treat skillchompas as a separate XP source; fold them into colony/HoM/Incandescent intensity notes when costing a route.
